svg.title: ShopLedger architecture and order placement
svg.desc: Current architecture verified from directory listings and source searches. Shows public UI, server.js, all four routers and all ten lib modules, config.js, data/db.json, selected real call relationships, and eight steps of a successful order. Purple highlights lib/invoice.js only. The invoice currently uses config directly, rather than lib/tax.js. Router uses lists refer to lib modules. Blue badges match the numbered order flow; selected arrows do not represent every import.
svg.text: Verified current implementation · selected real calls · blue badges match the order steps
Selected calls drawn; router uses-lists identify other dependencies.
Invoice currently reads config directly, not tax.js; its GST and coupon calculations differ from checkout.
saves stock, customer, order, ID, audit
